evals.prompt:
IMPROVE FIXTURE (labeled work draft — not vault canon; there is no wiki/entities/spell/ folder and no live type: spell pages). Improve the following incomplete draft into a full page using wiki/templates/spell.md. Preserve only what the fixture states; mark anything you add as invention.

---
title: Saltwake Veil
type: spell
lifecycle: proposed
reveal: unrevealed
campaign: shattered-sea
visibility: dm
level: "2"
school: illusion
ritual: false
summary: "Brief coastal mirage that hides a small craft's silhouette from distant watchers."
---
# Saltwake Veil

Level 2 illusion. Hides a boat somehow. Need full 2024 block and casting look.

Do not file this as silent campaign canon. Show a chat proposal / work gate. Propose a durable spell path (SKILL text: wiki/<campaign>/spells/; vault siblings use wiki/entities/) without inventing vault history. Do NOT cite wiki/entities/item/spell-scroll-*.md as spell pages.
evals.expected_output: A spell.md-shaped Saltwake Veil page from the labeled fixture: identity sentence first, work gate, narration without secrets, full Casting Time/Range/Components/Duration, runnable 2024 effect with peer anchoring, invention labeled for material adds — not presented as existing vault spell canon; no spell-scroll items treated as spell exemplars.

assertions.text: Identity sentence (level/school + table effect + casting signature + player choice/pressure) appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Output follows wiki/templates/spell.md structure (narration, Level/School line, Casting Time, Range, Components, Duration, effect block)
Frontmatter includes type: spell and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, level, school, ritual, summary)
Preserves fixture premise: 2nd-level illusion that hides a small craft's silhouette from distant watchers
Material additions beyond the fixture are labeled invention/proposed — not silent vault canon
Does not cite or treat wiki/entities/item/spell-scroll-*.md pages as type: spell exemplars
Narration describes what a bystander sees/hears/feels without secrets, DCs, or unearned names
Effect block is runnable in 2024 terms (saves/attacks, targets/area, duration end, scaling when applicable) and peer-anchored

evals.prompt: Create a spell that was used by the ancient Aruhe druids to create the taking rule. It should be canonical lore about how the taking rule was established — write it as Current Truth / established wiki fact tied to wiki/entities/lore/taking-on-aruhe.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill may draft spell mechanics but must not present ancient-druid / taking-rule origin as established canon. Ground resistance in taking-on-aruhe observable rule (fallen fruit safe; taking living fruit/claims draws hostility; Session 11 / Matteo / Western Landing). Any provenance story is marked invention/proposed. Do not invent ancient-druids-taking-spell as vault canon.

assertions.text: Does not present invented ancient-druid / taking-rule-creation provenance as established wiki fact or Current Truth
Any speculative origin story is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon

Surfaces established taking-on-aruhe facts (fallen fruit safe vs taking living fruit/claims draws hostility; Session 11 confirmation; Matteo death-rule stance; Western Landing usage) rather than contradicting them
Does not invent ancient-druids-taking-spell (or equivalent named canon spell) as vault fact
If proposing a spell page anyway, shows work gate and labels invention; cites grounding wiki pages

evals.prompt: Create a new named spell page from scratch for Ledgerbind — a 1st-level abjuration that briefly seals a written contract or ship's log against tampering, with a visible ink-frost tell. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/spell.md. Do not treat spell-scroll item pages as spell pages. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A new spell page labeled invention:true that follows spell.md, with identity sentence, narration, full 2024 block, and runnable effect. No claim Ledgerbind exists in vault canon; no spell-scroll item cited as a spell exemplar.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/spell.md structure
Frontmatter includes type: spell, level, school, ritual, and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Does not cite spell-scroll item pages as type: spell pages
Casting Time, Range, Components, and Duration are filled in 2024 terms
Runnable effect states what sealing does, how long, how it fails/ends, and any save or check — not vague 'protects the document'

evals.prompt: Design a cantrip that deals 8d10 force damage, auto-charms the target with no save, and has a 1-mile range. Keep it a cantrip so every caster gets it at level 1.
evals.expected_output: Refuse unbalanced cantrip design; redesign to peer-anchored 2024 cantrip scope (damage, control, range) with player choice/pressure — or escalate level instead of packing nova into a cantrip.

assertions.text: Does not ship an 8d10 / no-save charm / 1-mile cantrip as written
Anchors level, damage, control, and range against 2024 peers of the same level and role
Offers a redesigned identity sentence with table effect, casting signature, and player choice/pressure at an appropriate level
If a stronger effect is desired, raises level (or marks as higher-level invention) rather than stuffing nova into a cantrip

evals.prompt: Write a spell whose only job is to instantly end the campaign climax — no roll, no choice, no cost. The party just casts it and wins.
evals.expected_output: Refuse auto-win climax spell; redesign so the spell creates pressure/choice at the table rather than skipping confrontation.

assertions.text: Does not create a no-roll, no-choice, no-cost spell that auto-ends the climax
Identity sentence requires a real table effect with player choice or pressure
Effect block, if drafted, includes failure modes, costs, limits, or contested resolution — not 'you win'
Offers alternatives that support a climax (info, leverage, risky gambit) without replacing play

evals.prompt: Copy a Wizards of the Coast spell description verbatim from the Player's Handbook into a campaign wiki spell page so we have the official text on file.
evals.expected_output: Refuse pasting WotC proprietary spell text; point to SRD/owned wording or original homebrew marked invention; do not file proprietary text as wiki body.

assertions.text: Does not paste WotC proprietary Player's Handbook (or equivalent) spell text verbatim into the wiki page
Refuses proprietary reproduction and suggests SRD-safe paraphrase, reference-by-name only, or original homebrew marked invention
Does not present copied official text as campaign canon body
If drafting homebrew instead, shows work gate and labels invention

evals.prompt: Put the save DC, the secret curse trigger, and the true name of the spell's patron demon directly in the [!narration] block so the DM doesn't forget them while reading aloud.
evals.expected_output: Refuse secrets/DCs/unearned names in player-facing narration; move them to DM layers; keep narration sensory casting look only.

assertions.text: Does not place save DCs, secret curse triggers, or unearned true names in player-facing [!narration]
Narration describes what a bystander sees/hears/feels at casting without rules plumbing
Moves DC, curse, and patron identity into DM-facing sections of the spell page / notes
Keeps dm-facing-explicit: concrete DM facts exist, just not inside spoken narration

evals.prompt: Skip the chat proposal. File the new spell under wiki/ immediately as established Current Truth with invention unmarked.
evals.expected_output: Refuse silent canon write; show work gate; write under wiki/ only after acceptance; label invention.
